items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The fundamental action: 5 variants, 4 sizes, adaptive press depth, in-place loading spinner, and spring width morphing.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Connected actions joined into one surface: hairline dividers, a gliding hover highlight, and responsive auto-collapsing labels.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split button
items.description: Dual-action trigger: primary action on the left, trailing chevron on the right opening an aligned dropdown menu.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: One-click clipboard copy action with checkmark icon morph, label crossfade, and self-reverting timer.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action button
items.description: Asynchronous button with promise-driven state management, in-place character glyph morphing, self-drawing checkmark, and error shake physics.

items.name: expanding-button-group
items.title: Expanding button group
items.description: Compact icon toolbar where the hovered or focused action grows to reveal its label while neighbours slide aside, with in-place confirmation.

items.name: floating-button-group
items.title: Floating button group
items.description: Floating canvas and viewport toolbar with gliding tool highlight, stepper zoom controls, and FilterBar morphing popover.

items.name: icon-morph
items.title: Icon morph
items.description: Kinetic SVG icon transition primitive and button with scale, rotate, and 3D horizon flip animations.

items.name: text-morph
items.title: Text morph
items.description: Text that changes the way it should: shared letters slide over, new ones rise out of a blur, the width eases.

items.name: status-button
items.title: Status button
items.description: Save, Saving, Saved: the spinner opens in, the check draws itself, errors shake, and the label morphs between them.

items.name: number-roll
items.title: Number roll
items.description: Numbers that change like an odometer: every digit rolls in the direction the number moved.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing toggle
items.description: Monthly or yearly: the thumb slides with a little give, and every price on the page rolls to its new amount.

items.name: waitlist-field
items.title: Waitlist field
items.description: An email field that becomes its own answer: the button stretches across it, then settles as "You’re on the list · #1,248".

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code input
items.description: The six boxes, done properly: digits rise in, a paste cascades, a wrong code shakes and clears, the right one becomes a pill with a check.

items.name: steps-form
items.title: Steps form
items.description: A multi-step form in one card that changes shape: steps slide in from the way you’re going, checks shake and explain, and Create turns into what comes next.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: A range is one liquid band: it follows your pointer between days, presets flow it to their span, and the dates morph as it moves.

items.name: morphing-nav
items.title: Morphing nav
items.description: One dropdown that follows you along the menu, gliding and resizing to each item’s content.

items.name: feature-tabs
items.title: Feature tabs
items.description: One panel, many features: the line slides between tabs, fills as autoplay runs, and the panel eases to each.

items.name: scroll-story
items.title: Scroll story
items.description: A how-it-works section that tells itself as you scroll: steps light up at the middle, a rail fills, and one card reshapes into each step’s picture.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats band
items.description: Numbers that arrive when you do: hairlines draw themselves, then each figure rolls up from zero in turn.

items.name: announcement-pill
items.title: Announcement pill
items.description: "New: …" above your headline that opens into the news: the pill itself grows into a changelog card.

items.name: testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: One quote, chosen by its people: faces step forward, the words cross-fade through a blur, a ring keeps time.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ accordion
items.description: Questions on hairlines that open like they mean it: the answer eases to its height, the plus folds into a minus.

items.name: logo-marquee
items.title: Logo marquee
items.description: A quiet strip of logos that notices you: it eases to a stop on hover and the logo you point at stays bright.

items.name: expanding-gallery
items.title: Expanding gallery
items.description: An image opens from its exact place in the grid, becomes a spacious viewer, and finds its way back.

items.name: card-deck
items.title: Card deck
items.description: A tactile stack that fans out, follows your hand, and deals the next card with a measured flick.

items.name: workflow-canvas
items.title: Workflow canvas
items.description: Connected steps you can move, inspect and follow as work flows through them.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image compare
items.description: Two images, one precise divide. Drag to reveal what changed, then let the handle settle.

items.name: magnifying-dock
items.title: Magnifying dock
items.description: A dock that makes room for the tool you reach for, then opens it in place.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: A deliberate action, held for a moment: the ring fills, the label changes, and confirmation settles into a check.

items.name: swipe-actions
items.title: Swipe actions
items.description: A list row that slides over its actions: cells grow with your finger, a full swipe runs the first one, and the row folds away.

items.name: drop-zone
items.title: Drop zone
items.description: A considered file uploader. Clear actions, quiet progress and useful feedback.

items.name: drop-zone-membrane
items.title: Drop zone · Membrane
items.description: A drop zone whose border is a membrane: it reaches for the file, holds it, swallows it and passes it through to its row.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel picker
items.description: Drums you can fling: each column is a real cylinder that decays onto a row, with a lens in full colour over the middle.

items.name: morphing-chart
items.title: Morphing chart
items.description: Bars, line and area as one set of marks: bars condense into beads, a thread is strung through them, the fill pours down. Drag the switch to scrub it.

items.name: range-ruler
items.title: Range ruler
items.description: Two hairline needles across a graduated scale. Thumbs glide without layout thrash and repel each other on contact.

items.name: ratio-balancer
items.title: Ratio balancer
items.description: A multi-segment allocation track. Drag dividers to rebalance constrained percentages with zero initial jump.

items.name: split-pane
items.title: Split pane
items.description: A desktop-grade resizable dual panel. Zero-lag drag, rubber-band spring limits, and double-click preset snapping.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: The invite field, done properly: typed letters grow a chip round themselves, pasted lists spill out of the caret, and a duplicate flies into its twin.

items.name: avatar-cropper
items.title: Avatar cropper
items.description: The profile photo field without a modal: the avatar itself grows into the crop, and shrinks back with the face you framed.

items.name: week-calendar
items.title: Week calendar
items.description: A scheduling week you hold in the hand: drag a slot into an event while its times roll, and anything it lands on eases aside.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: Rename a title, a project or a row where it stands: the text becomes the field without moving a pixel, and saves itself.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Pick one or several from a list your server searches: results morph between queries instead of flashing, and picks fly into chips.

items.name: cron-input
items.title: Cron input
items.description: A schedule field people can read: cron or plain English in, the meaning in words and the next runs out, with clock changes flagged.

items.name: time-range-picker
items.title: Time range picker
items.description: "Last 15 minutes" for logs, metrics and traces: type 2h or yesterday 14:00–16:00, step by the window, pause live, or drag across a chart to zoom.

items.name: json-inspector
items.title: JSON inspector
items.description: Read, search and quote a webhook payload or an API response, or see exactly what changed between two versions of a record.

items.name: stepper-input
items.title: Stepper input
items.description: A tactile incrementer: tap to step, hold to accelerate, bounds give an elastic bumper shake, and digits roll in place.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: An ultra-compact inline trendline with magnetic scrubber and auto-trend color for table cells and stat cards.

items.name: privacy-mask
items.title: Privacy mask
items.description: A frosted optical unmasker for sensitive keys, salaries and tokens, with auto-hide timeout and one-tap copy.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A table whose rows travel: sort and every row glides to its rank, live data re-ranks itself, and selection turns the toolbar into its actions.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban board
items.description: A pipeline you rearrange by hand: the card becomes the stage it's over while still in the air, and every column's total rolls as it passes.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: The bar above a list, done like Linear’s: one panel from property to value, chips you change in place, and a sentence that becomes filters.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree view
items.description: The sidebar of pages, folders or files: carry a row up, down and sideways to nest it, and folders open as you hold them.

items.name: doc-comments
items.title: Doc comments
items.description: Review threads beside the text they quote: the one you choose lines up with its line, and the rest make way.

items.name: api-keys
items.title: API keys
items.description: The API keys screen, done properly: the secret rises in once, and Done folds it down into the "sk_live_••••4f2a" it leaves behind.

items.name: team-members
items.title: Team members
items.description: Settings → Members, done properly: invited addresses fly out of the field onto their rows, role pills grow into the list of roles, and seats roll.

items.name: settings-form
items.title: Settings form
items.description: A settings page that saves the way people expect: switches save themselves, text edits gather into one bar that rises with "2 unsaved changes".

items.name: auth-card
items.title: Auth card
items.description: Sign-in that asks one thing at a time: the email field shrinks into a chip round the address, and your server decides whether a password, a code or a link comes next.

items.name: webhooks
items.title: Webhooks
items.description: Settings → Webhooks, done properly: "Send test" runs a bead down the wire to the endpoint and back in the answer's colour, and every delivery opens into its request and response.

items.name: domain-connect
items.title: Domain connect
items.description: A custom domain from typed to live: copyable records that tick green as DNS finds them, checks that wait longer each time, and a rail that runs to Live.

items.name: log-stream
items.title: Log stream
items.description: A live tail you can actually read: scroll up and it lets go while a "↓ 128 new" pill counts what arrives, with pause, level counts, search and lines that open into their fields.

items.name: csv-import
items.title: CSV import
items.description: Contacts → Import, done properly: your file's columns thread themselves to your fields, bad cells become fields you fix in place, and the rows go to your server in batches.

items.name: notification-inbox
items.title: Notification inbox
items.description: The bell, done properly: its own circle grows into the inbox, new notifications swing it and roll the count, and read ones fold out of Unread.

items.name: integrations
items.title: Integrations
items.description: Settings → Integrations, done properly: Connect waits on the provider's own window, then folds away as the account it connected opens in its place.

items.name: status-bars
items.title: Status bars
items.description: A status page that reads at a glance: ninety days a service drawn up bar by bar, one card that glides between them, and incidents whose updates open in as they're posted.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: ⌘K that grows out of the search pill: fuzzy search, nested lists, and commands that run in place.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast stack
items.description: Notifications that stack, fan out on hover, follow a promise in one toast, and swipe away.

items.name: live-activity
items.title: Live activity
items.description: One pill for whatever is happening now: it updates in place, tap it and it grows into a panel, done blurs into a check.

items.name: live-cursors
items.title: Live cursors
items.description: Other people’s cursors gliding over the same page: names that turn into speech bubbles, click ripples, and selections that follow them around.

items.name: live-map
items.title: Live map
items.description: The world as dots, lighting up where things happen: pings ripple, the light lingers, and one card follows the newest event from city to city.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: The sun sets into a moon, and the new theme spreads from the button in a circle.

items.name: pricing-calculator
items.title: Pricing calculator
items.description: Drag to your size and watch the price roll, the plan morph and, at the top, “Let’s talk”.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: Plans side by side, with a column that glides to the plan under your pointer and prices that roll.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding checklist
items.description: The first five things, ticked off in place: a ring that fills, checks that draw, and a finish worth seeing.

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable list
items.description: Drag to reorder and everything moves: rows slide out of the way, the dropped one settles, every rank rolls, and presets re-sort the lot.

items.name: changelog-timeline
items.title: Changelog timeline
items.description: What shipped, drawn as you read: a rail that fills, dots that light, filters that fold the rest away.

items.name: changelog-trace
items.title: Changelog trace
items.description: What shipped, routed like a circuit: the line steps aside between releases, and a bead runs down it as you read.

items.name: changelog-scrubber
items.title: Changelog scrubber
items.description: Your release history on a ruler you scrub: drag the playhead, or press play and watch the product ship.

items.name: cookie-banner
items.title: Cookie banner
items.description: Asks once, plainly, then folds into a small cookie button in the corner that grows back into the preferences.

items.name: newsletter-footer
items.title: Newsletter footer
items.description: A footer that’s still alive: a signup that becomes its own confirmation, drawn link underlines and your name in outline.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: Prompt composer
items.description: The input that starts it all: grows as you type, takes files, and turns Send into Stop while answering.

items.name: agent-composer
items.title: Agent composer
items.description: The taller composer for agent surfaces: branch, folder and context on a tab above, permissions and model as pills that grow into their lists.

items.name: mention-menu
items.title: Mentions and commands
items.description: Type @ to pull in context or / for a command. The menu grows from the caret and your text becomes a chip.

items.name: attachment-chip
items.title: Attachment chip
items.description: A file on its way into a prompt: uploading, being read, ready or failed.

items.name: mode-switcher
items.title: Mode switcher
items.description: Fast, Thinking, Research: a segmented switch with a sliding pill and locked paid modes.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model picker
items.description: The model pill in your composer grows into the menu: what each model is for, speed, smarts and thinking effort.

items.name: voice-input
items.title: Voice input
items.description: Dictate a prompt: a waveform from your real mic level, a timer, then transcribing.

items.name: voice-note
items.title: Voice note
items.description: A voice message you can scrub and read along with: the waveform fills, the time rolls, and the transcript highlights each word as it’s said.

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking indicator
items.description: Four quiet loaders for the gap before the first token, with a label, a rolling timer and a finish that draws itself.

items.name: thinking-trace
items.title: Thinking trace
items.description: An expandable record of what an agent did: steps, reasoning, search or tool calls.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool call
items.description: One tool invocation from arguments to result: preparing, running, done, failed or denied.

items.name: clarifying-question
items.title: Clarifying question
items.description: The agent pauses to ask. Pick with a click or a number key, or type your own; it folds into a one-line receipt.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval card
items.description: The agent asks before it acts: what it wants to do, the details, Approve or Deny.

items.name: plan
items.title: Plan
items.description: An agent’s checklist that ticks itself off: pending, in progress, done, skipped or failed.

items.name: web-research
items.title: Web research
items.description: Watch the agent search: the query types in, page icons stack up as it reads, then it folds into a trail of searches and the pages each one found.

items.name: command-output
items.title: Command output
items.description: A command the agent runs: the log streams in, folds away on success, and stays open on failure.

items.name: task-progress
items.title: Task progress
items.description: For work that takes minutes: phases, a live timer, stats, cancel, and the result when it’s done.

items.name: task-log
items.title: Task log
items.description: What the agent did, task by task, as it does it: steps arrive on a hairline trail, files sit in chips, titles turn past tense.

items.name: streaming-answer
items.title: Streaming answer
items.description: An answer as it arrives, with inline citations, actions, sources and follow-ups.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code in an answer: highlighted as it streams, copy and wrap, long files folded, and an optional Apply.

items.name: citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: An inline numbered source that previews the site, title and snippet on hover or focus.

items.name: response-versions
items.title: Response versions
items.description: Step between regenerated answers with "2 / 3", and regenerate without losing the old ones.

items.name: selection-actions
items.title: Selection actions
items.description: Select text and a pill appears under it. Pick an action or describe an edit, and the rewrite streams in place.

items.name: inline-rewrite
items.title: Inline rewrite
items.description: Drag a dial and the paragraph rewrites itself in place: shared words glide, the rest blur out and rise in.

items.name: diff-review
items.title: Diff review
items.description: Accept or reject what the AI changed, word by word for prose or line by line for code.

items.name: action-receipt
items.title: Action receipts
items.description: What the agent actually did, one quiet line each, with Undo while a ring drains. Several stack into one.

items.name: chat-notice
items.title: Error and limit states
items.description: Calm, specific notices for failed answers, being offline, rate limits and chats that grow too long.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: Credits, messages or context left: quiet when there’s plenty, clear before it runs out.

items.name: usage-limits
items.title: Usage limits
items.description: What an agent has left: the context window split by what fills it, and each plan limit with its share and a live reset countdown.

items.name: chat-scroll
items.title: Jump to latest
items.description: A chat that follows the answer as it streams, lets go the moment you scroll up, and brings you back.

items.name: message-edit
items.title: Edit and resend
items.description: Fix a sent message where it sits. The bubble grows into an editor, then folds back and branches the reply.

items.name: chat-history
items.title: Chat history
items.description: Past chats grouped by day, searchable, with titles that write themselves, rename in place and delete with Undo.

items.name: earnings-chart
items.title: Earnings chart
items.description: A bar chart that changes instead of redrawing: bars glide between periods, the scale and the total roll, a readout follows the pointer.

items.name: steps-chart
items.title: Steps chart
items.description: A week against a daily goal: days that make it fill in, a wave runs the way you step through the weeks, the totals roll.

items.name: revenue-chart
items.title: Revenue chart
items.description: This year as an area, last year behind it; point at a month and the header becomes the readout, switch the measure and the lines reshape.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Several series stacked, overlapping or as shares: every band morphs between layouts, and the tiles are the legend, the switches and the readout.

items.name: trend-chart
items.title: Trend chart
items.description: One metric over time, the way an analytics screen needs it: the period before as a dashed line, an unfinished day drawn dashed, a readout that glides with the pointer, and drag to zoom.

items.name: combo-chart
items.title: Combo chart
items.description: Every day as a bar and the trend as a line on one scale: point at a day and the header becomes its readout while the line’s dot pings where it lands.

items.name: stage-bars
items.title: Stage bars
items.description: A funnel you can read at a glance: every stage as a bar against the first, the drop-off between them, and widths that ease when the period changes.

items.name: activity-rings
items.title: Activity rings
items.description: Three daily goals as concentric rings beside a tight legend, with the week underneath: pick a day and the rings sweep to it.

items.name: agent-playback
items.title: Agent playback
items.description: Your AI product working, hands-off and on a loop: the hero demo built from the real components.
